report_title: GadgetsOnline SQL Server to PostgreSQL Migration - Final Report
status_detail: The application was already partially migrated to PostgreSQL (Npgsql packages, connection strings, provider configuration, EF6 model mappings with gadgetsonline_dbo schema and lowercase naming were in place). All 19 SQL statements were extracted, submitted to DMS for conversion (all failed), manually converted with lowercase schema mapping, and validated through the SQL equivalency tool (all returned ERROR). The build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
